title: Chidamide Plus DICE Regimen for Patients With Relapse or Refractory B-cell Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma (NHL)
brief_summary: This is a prospective phase II clinical trial to observe the efficacy and safety of Chidamide combined with DICE (Dexamethasone, Ifosfamide, Cisplatin and Etoposide) in patients with relapsed or refractory B-cell Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma (NHL).
